description: Manages system-level administrative tasks, including database migrations and other core system operations.

endpoints.name: RunMigrations
endpoints.description: Initiates the process to run pending database migrations. This operation updates the database schema to the latest version. It is typically used during deployment or maintenance.
example_uses: Execute pending database changes for the system.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when the system's database schema needs to be updated to the latest version, typically after a new deployment or during a maintenance window. This operation should be performed with caution as it modifies the database structure.
